stem: A harvest task now requires a technical repair outside Technician I training. What should happen?
choices: Attempt the repair because harvest is time-sensitive
Stop the affected work and escalate the repair need rather than improvising
rationale: Stop the affected work and escalate the repair need rather than improvising. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
